subject: [hw] X01 rev 3 (no count change): errno fallback + docs; 439/439; commit 1d29f4a
body:
Small cleanup after rev 2, no behavior change in any tested path:

- n2vc_hw_wrap_log returns -EIO if fopen() fails without setting errno (instead of 0).
- log2script.py: removed redundant valid_reg checks after the early returns (same output).
- README/STATUS: documented that an IRQ has one last-observed status rule and that a failed read is parsed but never replayed as a value.

    bash gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST X01 PASS 439/439  (13 s this run; ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan, cap0, iOS compile, literal log, round trip, diff exact line)

Commit 1d29f4a. Not-done list unchanged. Still available for R1/lead findings.
